title: a figure of Ideographic baseline differs from the definition

labels.name: i18n-tracker
labels.description: Group bringing to attention of Internationalization, or tracked by i18n but not needing response.

labels.name: i18n-jlreq
labels.description: Notifies Japanese script experts of relevant issues

body:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1079715/99475298-a0d14c80-2991-11eb-9b39-d8f47dce9b67.png)
<https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/baselines.png> (referred in <https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#text-styles>)
The image above seems to show the ideographic baseline as [ideographic character face](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/baselinetags#icfbox) bottom edge, but actually it should be [ideographic em-box](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/baselinetags#ideoembox) bottom edge by definition.

Ideographic em-box is called as [character frame](https://www.w3.org/TR/jlreq/#term.character-frame) in [Requirements for Japanese Text Layout](https://www.w3.org/TR/jlreq/).

## Related specs

WHATWG Canvas: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-textbaseline-ideographic
> ideographic: The ideographic-under baseline

CSS Inline Module: https://drafts.csswg.org/css-inline/#ideographic-under-baseline
> ideographic-under: Corresponds to the line-under design edge of CJK (Han/Hangul/Kana) text. Assigned to ideo in OpenType. 

OpenType: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/baselinetags
> 'ideo': Ideographic em-box bottom edge.
